title: Ultra Ethernet Transport-style packet delivery sublayer, one PDC in reliable unordered delivery: PSNs, a retransmit window, cumulative and selective ACKs, NACKs for no receive buffer, a retransmit timer

fields.desc: the PDC is open; clearing it drops every packet, frame and buffer and loads the start PSNs
the first PSN this end sends
the first PSN this end expects

regs.name: TX
regs.desc: Packet byte to send; one write per byte, LAST on the final byte (a packet is cut after MAXP = 16 bytes). Bytes are taken while the retransmit window (W = 4 packets) has room

regs.name: RX
regs.desc: Received packet byte (packets in arrival order); reading it pops it. While RX is not read the core's RXB = 2 receive buffers fill and further packets are NACKed

fields.desc: packets written and not yet acknowledged (0..4)

irqs.name: RTO
irqs.desc: the retransmit timer expired: every unacknowledged packet is sent again

irqs.name: NACK
irqs.desc: a NACK arrived: that packet is sent again

irqs.name: DUP
irqs.desc: a packet received before arrived again (dropped, ACKed)

irqs.name: NOBUF
irqs.desc: a new packet found no receive buffer: dropped and NACKed

irqs.name: ERR_PROTO
irqs.desc: a bad frame (type, length) or an ACK / NACK / PSN no peer could send: dropped

notes: net_tx_* and net_rx_* are the network (MAC client) frames; they pass through unchanged.
The core parameters MAXP (16), W (4), RXB (2) and RTO (256 clocks) keep their defaults.
